modal.help_s1b: Shintsha Amadrayivu wawo wonke amavolumu, + Engeza ifolda ukuze wengeze, u-x ususa eyodwa, noma namathisela izindlela ezihlukaniswe nge-`;` ku-Hlela. Ukushintsha amathebhu kushintsha amafolda.
modal.help_s2b: Igama, i-Regex (i-syntax ye-Rust), i-Fuzzy, Okuqukethwe kwefayela, i-Glob (*.rs), Okukodwa-kokuningi (NOMA) / Akukho-kokuningi (CHA), usayizi (amabhayithi noma i-10M/1G), izinsuku (YYYY-MM-DD), uhlu loku-Khipha, Izandiso noma amaqembu (ayafaka esikhundleni, chofoza futhi ukuze usule; u-Phatha uhlela angokwezifiso), Nganaki usonhlamvu omkhulu/omncane, Bonisa okufihliwe.
modal.help_s3b: Inkinobho enkulu ethi Skena useshe noma u-Enter. Uku-Vuselela kuphinda kuqhube kugcine ukukhetha. U-Bukhoma uziqhuba ngokuzenzakalela (kuvaliwe ekuqaleni). Usesho olungenalutho aluqhubeki — faka u-* ku-Glob wakho konke.
modal.help_s4b: Izihloko ezincane ziyahlunga, u-Yiya weqa amakhasi, amabhokisi okuhlola anika Kopisha izindlela / Thutha / Susa kanye nokuthumela ngaphandle kwe-CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Usesho olulondoloziwe nezithombe Zakwamuva zibuyisela sonke isihlungi kufaka phakathi amafolda, NOMA/CHA, nokufihliwe.
modal.help_keys_body: U-Enter uyasesha · u-Esc wehlisa ukugxila / uvala izingxoxo · u-↑/↓ uhambisa ukukhetha · u-Space umaka umugqa · u-Tab uhamba phakathi kwezilawuli.
